findings.objectiveReason: The singular Сестра is shorthand for the female cousin already introduced by Neighbour_Entrance_1/2. Both nodes branch directly to Neighbour_Entrance_3; its parallel branch _4 repeats двоюродная сестра. خواهرم changes this same referent into a sibling. Preserve the established cousin relationship without selecting a paternal/maternal branch.

findings.source: Tough: Нечасто фотографируюсь. Но давай, чего бы и не посмотреть, что получится.
findings.target: Tough: زیاد از خودم عکس نمی‌گیرم. اما بزن بریم، چرا نبینیم چه از آب درمی‌آید؟
findings.proposedTarget: Tough: کم پیش می‌آید از من عکس بگیرند. اما بزن بریم، چرا نبینیم چه از آب درمی‌آید؟
findings.objectiveReason: Russian reflexive фотографируюсь means the speaker is the photo subject. از خودم عکس نمی‌گیرم makes her the photographer taking a selfie. Compiled Tough_Photo advances directly to ShowSign Tough AURAPHOTO; the player performs the photo check. Preserve every unchanged sentence.
findings.contextEvidence: compiled-context.json node Tough_Photo; approved photo-check and tough-woman glossary entries
